body:
Fixed in objectstack-ai/cloud#341 (merged).

Root cause: better-auth 1.6.x defers the `user.create.after` personal-org provisioning hook via `queueAfterTransactionHook`, so it runs only after the signup transaction commits — while the auto-sign-in session is created inline within that same operation. The active-org `session.create.before` hook therefore fires before any `sys_member` exists and leaves `activeOrganizationId` null.

Fix (option a): after provisioning in the deferred hook (session row is committed by then), backfill the resolved org onto the user's still-org-less session(s). Only fills null fields, no-ops when email-verification defers sign-in, swallows all errors.

Verified by a new e2e assertion in `apps/cloud/test/signup-org-flow.test.ts` — a plain `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` after a fresh signup now resolves the personal org with no manual set-active (assertion confirmed failing without the fix).
